title: Store Screenshot Studio
description: Making App Store screenshots takes hours, and most tools give you the same boring templates. This Claude Code skill does the design work for you. Give it your app screens, pick the colors and the idea you like, and it makes every size the App Store and Google Play need.

title: Flaran
description: AI can write your Flutter code, but you still need to see the app with your own eyes. Flaran puts run, hot reload and hot restart buttons in your Mac menu bar. When the AI finishes a task, one click and you see the change. No IDE, no typing commands.

title: Drift DB Inspector
description: Ever wondered what your app really saved on the phone? Plug in your Android phone, type the app id, and Drift DB Inspector copies the app's database to your Mac. Then you can look through every table and search the rows in a simple viewer.

title: TypeSpeed
description: How fast can you type on your phone? Pick a timer or a word count and start typing. TypeSpeed shows your speed (WPM) and accuracy, and confetti pops when you beat your best score. Copy and paste? Nice try, that run doesn't count.

title: Weather Assistant - Flutter MCP
description: Ask about the weather the way you would ask a friend: "How's the weather in Dhaka?" The AI understands the question, gets live data from a small weather server built with MCP, and answers with a clean weather card. A fun way to show how MCP lets AI use real tools.

title: Tyke - Shoe App
description: One of my first Flutter projects, from when I was just starting out. Even back then I loved small animations that make an app feel alive. Swipe through the shoes, tap one and watch it fly into the details page, then slide to add it to your cart.
